title: 第5章  今日，神挡杀神！
content_zh:
王凡憋得青筋暴突，口中含混不清：
“我……不知道！”
“既然不知道，那就去死！”
手上一用力，王凡脖子应声而断。
全场鸦雀无声，死一般寂静。
王凡到死都不相信，自己会死的如此憋屈。
都没来得及施展杀招。
陆烬看也不看，一甩手把死人扔地上，抬眸扫视前方。
一群弟子眼神惊恐，不由自主后撤。
众人此时方才明白，如今陆烬强势归来，再也不是那个在魔窟中丧失修为的废物！
至于他强大到什么地步，连王凡都能秒杀，肯定不会低于九重灵珠境！
“他恢复到三年前的巅峰战力了！”
“我等根本不是对手！可圣女峰的内门长老们却不在山峰，这可如何是好？”
“都这时候了，姬邀月峰主怎么还不现身？难道要继续看着弟子丧命他手么！”
“速速请其他峰长老啊！”
说话间，已经有人发了传音符。
三日来，戮仙峰这边的雷霆接连不断，早已引起了宗门注意，现在发生了这种事情，早就有内门长老闻讯而动，传音符刚发出去没多久，便有数道人影从别的峰掠来，个个气息强大，甚至还有一尊一品金丹境长老现身！
如今的万剑宗，除了八大峰主掌控各峰外，每座山峰还有数名内门长老，每位内门长老座下几乎都分配着几十名内门弟子。
至于宗主，神龙见首不见尾，甚至连宗门大比这等大事，都很少现身。
此时出现在这里那位金丹长老，正是隔壁九剑峰内门长老，罗鹫。

其他长老虽修为没达到金丹境，但几乎清一色九重灵珠境，这般阵容，也足以震撼人心。
看到来人，陆烬眸色微变，却没半分畏惧。
今日，神挡杀神！
罗鹫降临而下，全身气息弥漫，周身空气嗡鸣，威压四射！
“是九剑峰内门罗鹫长老！”
“金丹强者前来，必能将他诛杀！”
“陆烬这个孽障，今日必死！”
见到来人，周围一群弟子纷纷议论，满眼幸灾乐祸。
而此时的罗鹫等人，目光也看到了场中躺着的尸体，面色发寒。
“罗长老！他就是陆烬！他之前杀了卢长老师徒，现在又杀了王凡师兄！”
一名弟子跑上前去，指着陆烬咬牙切齿道。
“本长老已知悉。”
罗鹫皱眉，又问道：
“圣女峰诸位高层何在？”
那弟子道：
“众长老集体出动去黑龙河猎杀水妖去了，峰主大人应该在为圣女闭关护法，这才让他得逞！”
罗鹫点了点头，冷眼看向陆烬，微微有些意外，但很快便恢复不容亵渎的神态：
“没想到，你消失三年还活着，小子，今日本长老就亲自坐镇，新仇旧恨一并清算，为万剑宗清理门户！”
听到这话，其他几位长老也纷纷说道：
“罗长老说得对！”

“陆烬，别以为三年过去，你勾结魔窟屠杀我万剑宗弟子之事会被遗忘！”
“三年前你已是丹田破碎的废物，如今又有战力，定是修了邪魔外道之法！”
“这三年你去了何处，如实招来！”
喝声如雷，颐指气使，威严得让人不敢直视。
陆烬眸光低垂，微微摇头，唇角勾起冰冷弧度。
沉吟片刻，他忽然抬头道：
“废话就别说了，你们一起上吧。”
此话一出，众人全都一怔！
旋即却大笑起来：
“陆烬，你太自大了！”
“你的修为不过区区五重灵珠境，靠着不为人知的手段才斩杀了王凡他们，你以为凭着这些，就能跟我等长老叫嚣？”
“不过话说回来，你三年不死反倒有了修为，引发三日雷劫秒杀八重灵珠境，陆烬，你身上的宝贝逆天呐！”
“交出手中至宝，或可饶你不死！”
陆烬皱眉：
“废话真多！”
闻言，众人眸光更加森冷。
一名九重灵珠境长老顿时暴起，周身灵气弥漫，一柄飞剑从纳戒飞出，悬浮头顶，寒芒乍泄。
“陆烬，你太嚣张了！本长老且先将你拿下！”
这名长老名叫牛彼岸，虽身为外门长老，但其实力乃九重灵珠境，乃是统领外门的存在，地位极高，根本不是卢长老那等修为能比的。
“牛长老，千万别直接杀了他，这小子身上有秘密，我等要仔细审问！”

“罗长老放心，我会将他生擒！”
牛长老话音未落，头顶飞剑震荡，灵气催动下，骤然对着陆烬斩落！
“万剑宗中品剑诀，剑刺九式？”
陆烬淡笑，动也未动：
“大衍化龙诀，第一层，龙膜！”
法诀念动，体内灵力涌入掌心，一层白光浮现，竟是徒手朝着那飞剑抓过去。
这一幕，让不少人眉头一皱。
“他竟要硬接牛长老的飞剑！简直不自量力！”
“呵呵，这是放弃抵抗了么？”
“愚蠢！”
众人惊愕间，下一秒，却似看到了不可思议的一幕，嘴里的话还未说完，直接原地僵住！
牛长老的飞剑闪电般刺出，眨眼飞至陆烬面前，却在陆烬那推出去的手掌心处，骤然停滞！
“什么？这怎么可能！”
“徒手接飞剑？而且好像还阻住了飞剑的攻势？”
“这家伙到底修炼了什么歪门邪术？那可是牛长老的杀手锏！”
“……”
众人愕然间，却听到咔嚓一声。
随着陆烬手掌用力，那飞剑竟是直接被抓碎而去！
牛长老满脸惊愕，“这怎么可能！”
可惊愕间，忽感脑门一凉。

一块飞剑碎屑直接刺穿了他眉心，从后脑带出一线脑浆。
见到这一幕，所有人难以置信，那罗鹫更是眉头皱起，当着他的面，陆烬竟轻描淡写杀了牛长老，这让他无法接受！
陆烬叹了口气，轻轻推倒还站着的牛长老，淡淡道：
“我就想找柳如烟报个仇，你们非上赶着送死，怎么想的？”
话音落下，他也不再废话，身形忽然向前爆冲，掌心灵力凝聚，目标赫然便是内门长老，罗鹫！
众人又是一惊！
“什么？他竟敢对罗长老率先发难！”
“蚍蜉撼树！”
“找死！”
罗鹫颇感意外，立刻动手反击！
陆烬能空手接飞剑，秒杀牛长老，他虽身为一重金丹强者，却也没有托大，一出手便是杀招。
“百剑斩！”
灵光浮动，灵气呼啸间，一百把灵气凝聚的长剑虚影密密麻麻冲向陆烬，宛若齐发的箭矢，震荡虚空，噌然刺下！
面对如此威势，陆烬眸色冰冷，那一层白色龙膜再次幻化而出，眨眼化作光球将自己笼罩在内。
这是修炼大衍化龙诀初阶时所能施展出来的防御之力，面对对方如此强势攻击，陆烬不得不谨慎起来。
金丹境的战力，比起灵珠境，不止强了一星半点。
砰砰砰——
灵剑呼啸，撞击在白光防御上面，宛若巨石砸入湖面，陡然爆发巨大涟漪，轰鸣不绝！
现场灵气混乱，陆烬身形被笼罩其中变得朦胧。
见此情形，众人纷纷惊呼。

“罗长老如此攻势，他必死无疑！”
“能接下罗长老十道灵剑，已经是他的极限！”
“百剑斩乃万剑宗十大玄品高阶战技之一，威力巨大，他区区五重灵珠境，能坚持到这一步已经死而无憾了。”
“……”
混乱的战场中，上百灵剑不断刺下，大地颤抖，沙飞石走！
而就在这时，那灵剑爆炸所产生的混乱灵气，忽然被一股巨大吸力吞噬。
陆烬皱眉：
“葬天棺连这个都能吞噬？”
就在他愕然间，一股精纯灵气再次灌注体内，丹田之中，第六颗灵珠逐渐开始显现内核。
而当第六颗灵珠显现的同时，一部武学再次涌入脑海。
"孽火镇狱剑！"
"灵力化为火剑，清洗一切罪孽！炼至登峰造极，孽火万道，化作万剑牢狱，镇杀一切！"
“来得正是时候，可想要凝练火剑，却需要异火灵气来催发，眼下无法动用，不过，百剑斩对付罗鹫，足够了！”
“而且……”
他声音忽然传出：
“百剑斩，可不是你这么用的！”
声音未落，一股狂暴灵气骤然迸发，那一片沙土纷扬的混乱之地中，灵气飞剑呼啸而出，竟是以同样的招式，爆刺罗鹫！
飞剑于二人之间的空气中猛烈撞击，发出尖锐爆炸声，众人心惊肉跳，满脸不可思议。
“他竟还能反击！”
“据我所知，百剑斩是陆烬三年前所能修炼的最强大武学，若此番他招数用尽，便黔驴技穷了！”

“呵呵，罗鹫长老已经能凝聚一百六十把飞剑，登峰造极，岂是他能抗衡的！”
“不对劲！快看！”
噌噌噌——
众人震惊中，只见罗鹫长老凝聚出的飞剑已然用尽，却并没能击败陆烬，反而从陆烬所在之地，不断射出飞剑，洪流般涌向罗鹫！
“什么？！这怎么可能！”
罗鹫懵了，满眼惊恐！
粗看之下，陆烬凝聚的飞剑足有五百之多！
“众长老，还不出手助我！”
罗鹫情急爆喝，满眼惊恐！
陆烬却眸光一冷：
“挡我者，死！”
content_en:
Wang Fan couldn't hold it in until his veins popped out, and he slurred in his mouth:
"I... don't know!"
"If you don't know, then go to hell!"
With a strong force on his hand, Wang Fan's neck was broken.
The whole place was silent, deathly silent.
Wang Fan didn't believe until his death that he would die so aggrieved.
He didn't even have time to use his killing move.
Lu Jin didn't even look at it, threw the dead man to the ground with a wave of his hand, raised his eyes and scanned the front.
A group of disciples had frightened eyes and retreated involuntarily.
Only then did everyone realize that now that Lu Jin had returned powerfully, he was no longer the loser who had lost his cultivation in the Demon Cave!
As for how powerful he is, he can kill even Wang Fan in an instant, and he will definitely not be lower than the ninth level spiritual pearl realm!
"He has returned to his peak strength three years ago!"
"We are no match at all! But the inner elders of Saintess Peak are not on the mountain. What should we do?"
"It's already here, why doesn't Master Ji Yaoyue show up yet? Do you want to continue to watch your disciples die at his own hands?"
"Please quickly invite other peak elders!"
While he was talking, someone had already sent out the transmission talisman.
In the past three days, there have been continuous thunders on the Immortal Killing Peak, which has already attracted the attention of the sect. Now that something like this has happened, the elders of the inner sect have already heard the news and took action. Not long after the transmission notes were sent out, several figures came from other peaks, all with powerful auras, and even a first-grade golden elixir realm elder appeared!
Today, in the Wanjian Sect, in addition to the eight peak masters controlling each peak, there are also several inner sect elders on each peak. Each inner sect elder is assigned almost dozens of inner sect disciples.
As for the sect leader, Shenlong rarely shows up at important events such as sect competitions.
The Jindan elder who appeared here at this time was none other than the elder of the inner sect of Nine Swords Peak next door, Luo Jiu.
Although the other elders have not reached the Golden Core Realm, they are almost all at the Ninth Level Spiritual Pearl Realm. Such a lineup is enough to shock people's hearts.
Seeing the person coming, Lu Jin's eyes changed slightly, but he was not afraid at all.
Today, God blocks and kills God!
Luo Jiu came down, his whole body was filled with aura, and the air around him buzzed with pressure!
"It's Elder Menluo Vulture from Nine Swords Peak!"
"If a strong man from the golden elixir comes, he will definitely be killed!"
"Lu Jin, this evil obstacle, will die today!"
Seeing the visitor, a group of disciples around him started talking and gloating about his misfortune.
At this time, Luo Jiu and others also saw the corpse lying in the field, and their expressions turned cold.
"Elder Luo! He is Lu Jin! He killed Elder Lu and his disciple before, and now he has killed Senior Brother Wang Fan!"
A disciple ran forward, pointed at Lu Jin and gritted his teeth.
"This elder is aware of this."
Luo Jiu frowned and asked again:
"Where are the senior leaders of Saintess' Peak?"
The disciple said:
"All the elders collectively went to the Black Dragon River to hunt the water monsters. The peak master should be in retreat to protect the saint, so he succeeded!"
Luo Jiu nodded and looked at Lu Jin coldly. He was slightly surprised, but soon returned to his demeanor that could not be blasphemed:
"I didn't expect that you would still be alive after disappearing for three years. Boy, today the Japanese elder will personally take charge of the matter, settle old and new grudges, and clear the door for Wanjian Sect!"
After hearing this, several other elders also said:
"Elder Luo is right!"
"Lu Jin, don't think that after three years, your collusion with the Devil's Nest to massacre my Wanjian Sect disciples will be forgotten!"
"Three years ago, you were a waste with a broken Dantian. Now you have fighting power. You must have practiced the evil heretic method!"
"Where have you been in the past three years? Tell me the truth!"
He shouted like thunder, commanded, and was so majestic that no one dared to look directly at him.
Lu Jin lowered his eyes, shook his head slightly, and raised the corners of his lips in a cold arc.
After pondering for a moment, he suddenly raised his head and said:
"Stop talking nonsense and come on together."
As soon as these words came out, everyone was startled!
Then he burst out laughing:
"Lu Jin, you are too arrogant!"
"Your cultivation level is only at the fifth level of the Spiritual Bead Realm.Wang Fan and the others were killed by various means. Do you think that with this, you can make noises with me and other elders? "
"But having said that, you have not died for three years but you have developed a level of cultivation, causing a three-day thunder catastrophe to instantly kill the eighth-level spirit bead realm. Lu Jin, the treasure you have is incredible! "
"Hand over the treasure in your hand, and you may be spared from death! "
Lu Jin frowned:
“So much nonsense! "
Hearing this, everyone's eyes became even colder.
A ninth-level spiritual pearl realm elder suddenly burst into flames, and his whole body was filled with spiritual energy. A flying sword flew out from Najie, floating above his head, and a cold light was released.
"Lu Jin, you are too arrogant! This elder will take you down first! "
This elder's name is Niu Bi'an. Although he is an elder of the outer sect, his strength is at the ninth level of the spiritual pearl realm. He is the leader of the outer sect. His status is extremely high and cannot be compared to Elder Lu's level of cultivation.
"Elder Niu, don't kill him directly. This kid has secrets, and we will interrogate him carefully! "
"Don't worry, Elder Luo, I will capture him alive! "
Before Elder Niu finished speaking, the flying sword above his head vibrated, and under the influence of spiritual energy, he suddenly slashed at Lu Jin!
"Wanjian Sect's middle-grade sword art, nine sword thrust styles? "
Lu Jin smiled lightly and did not move:
"Dayan Dragon Transformation Technique, the first level, Dragon Membrane! "
As he read the magic formula, the spiritual power in his body poured into his palm, and a layer of white light emerged, and he actually grabbed the flying sword with his bare hands.
This scene made many people frown.
"He actually wanted to catch Elder Niu's flying sword! It’s simply overestimating one’s abilities! "
"Haha, are you giving up resistance? "
"madness! "
Everyone was stunned. The next second, they seemed to have seen an incredible scene. Before they could finish speaking, they froze on the spot!
Elder Niu's flying sword thrust out like lightning and flew in front of Lu Jin in the blink of an eye, but suddenly stopped in the palm of Lu Jin's pushed out hand!
"What? How is this possible! "
"Catching a flying sword with your bare hands? And it seems to have blocked Feijian's offensive? "
"What kind of evil magic has this guy practiced? That is Elder Niu’s trump card! "
"..."
Everyone was stunned when they heard a click.
With the force of Lu Jin's palm, the flying sword was directly smashed into pieces!
Elder Niu’s face was filled with astonishment, “How is this possible! "
But in the midst of shock, he suddenly felt a chill on his forehead.
A fragment of the flying sword pierced directly between his eyebrows, bringing out a sliver of brain from the back of his head.
Seeing this scene, everyone was in disbelief. Luo Jiu even frowned. In front of him, Lu Jin downplayed killing Elder Niu, which he couldn't accept!
Lu Jin sighed, gently pushed down Elder Niu who was still standing, and said calmly:
"I just want to take revenge on Liu Ruyan, but you guys are rushing to die, what do you think? "
After the words fell, he stopped talking nonsense, and suddenly rushed forward, condensing his spiritual power in his palms, and the target was clearly the elder of the inner sect, Luo Jiu!
Everyone was shocked again!
"What? How dare he take the lead in attacking Elder Luo! "
“The worm shakes the tree! "
"Seeking death! "
Luo Jiu was surprised and immediately started to fight back!
Lu Jin could catch the flying sword with his bare hands and kill Elder Niu in an instant. Although he was a first-level golden elixir powerhouse, he didn't have too much power, so he used his killing move.
“A hundred sword cuts! "
As the aura floated and the aura roared, a hundred long swords condensed with aura rushed toward Lu Jin in dense phantoms. They were like arrows fired in unison, shaking the void and stabbing down suddenly!
Facing such power, Lu Jin's eyes turned cold, and the layer of white dragon film transformed out again, turning into a ball of light in the blink of an eye to envelope him.
This is the defensive power that can be exerted in the initial stage of practicing Dayan Transformation Dragon Art. Faced with such a strong attack from the opponent, Lu Jin had to be cautious.
The combat power of the Golden Core Realm is more than a little bit stronger than that of the Spiritual Pearl Realm.
Bang bang bang——
The spirit sword roared and hit the white light defense. It was like a huge boulder smashing into the lake. Huge ripples suddenly erupted and the roar continued!
The spiritual energy at the scene was chaotic, and Lu Jin's figure was shrouded in it and became hazy.
Seeing this situation, everyone exclaimed.
"If Elder Luo attacks like this, he will definitely die!"
"Being able to take on Elder Luo's ten spiritual swords is already his limit!"
"Hundred Swords Slash is one of the ten high-level profound battle skills of Wanjian Sect. It is extremely powerful. He is only at the fifth level of the Spiritual Bead Realm. If he can persist to this point, he will die without regrets."
"..."
In the chaotic battlefield, hundreds of swords stabbed down continuously, the earth trembled, sand flew and rocks flew away!
At this moment, the chaotic spiritual energy generated by the explosion of the spiritual sword was suddenly swallowed up by a huge suction force.
Lu Jin frowned:
"Can the Sky Burial Coffin swallow even this?"
Just as he was stunned, a stream of pure spiritual energy poured into his body again, and in his dantian, the sixth spiritual bead gradually began to reveal its core.
And when the sixth spirit bead appeared, a piece of martial arts came into his mind again.
"Evil Fire Hell Sword!"
"Spiritual power turns into a fire sword to cleanse all sins! Refined to the peak, the evil fires turn into a prison of ten thousand swords to suppress everything!"
"I came at the right time, but if I want to condense the fire sword, I need the strange fire aura to activate it. I can't use it now. However, the Hundred Sword Slash is enough to deal with Luo Jiu!"
"And..."
His voice suddenly came out:
"Hundred Sword Slash is not how you use it!"
Before the voice fell, a violent spiritual energy suddenly burst out. In the chaotic land of sand and dust, the spiritual energy flying sword roared out, and it actually used the same move to stab the Luo Vulture!
The flying sword collided violently in the air between the two people, making a sharp explosion. Everyone was frightened and their faces were full of disbelief.
"He can actually fight back!"
"As far as I know, Hundred Sword Cut is the most powerful martial art that Lu Jin could practice three years ago. If he runs out of tricks this time, he will be at the end of his rope!"
"Haha, Elder Luo Jiu has already been able to gather one hundred and sixty flying swords and reached the pinnacle. How can he be able to compete with him!"
"Something's wrong! Look!"
Miso miso miso——
Everyone was shocked to see that the flying swords condensed by Elder Luo Jiu had been exhausted, but they failed to defeat Lu Jin. Instead, flying swords were continuously shot from the place where Lu Jin was, rushing towards Luo Jiu like a torrent!
"What?! How is this possible!"
Luo Jiu was stunned, his eyes full of horror!
At a glance, Lu Jin's condensed flying swords totaled five hundred!
"Elders, why don't you help me!"
Luo Jiu shouted anxiously, his eyes full of horror!
Lu Jin's eyes turned cold:
"Anyone who stands in my way will die!"
